title: Andouille Hash and Eggs
description: A hearty breakfast recipe featuring andouille sausage, crispy hash browns, and fluffy eggs.
instructions: Cook hash browns according to package instructions.
Slice andouille sausage into 1/2-inch thick rounds.
Heat a large oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Add sausage to skillet and cook until browned, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Remove sausage from skillet and set aside.
Crack eggs into skillet and scramble until cooked through.
Add cooked hash browns to skillet and stir to combine with eggs.
Return sausage to skillet and stir to combine with egg and hash brown mixture.
Bake in preheated oven for an additional 2-3 minutes, until cheese is melted and bubbly (if using).
